title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Cases Involving Patent Evaluation Reports

articles.content_en:
July 30, 2025
Supreme People's Court
Reply on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Cases Involving Patent Right Evaluation Reports
Fa Shi [2025] No. 11
Higher People's Court of Guizhou Province:
Your court's "Request for Instructions on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Patent Right Evaluation Reports" (Qian Gao Fa Qing [2024] No. 1) has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:
Pursuant to the provisions of Article 66, paragraph 2 of the Patent Law of the People's Republic of China, the patent right evaluation report made by the patent administration department under the State Council shall be evidence for the People's Court in hearing cases of infringement disputes over patent rights. Where a patent right evaluation report considers that the patent in question does not meet the conditions for granting patent rights as stipulated in the Patent Law of the People's Republic of China, the People's Court shall not directly rule to dismiss the prosecution solely on that basis, but shall provide clarification in light of the specific circumstances of the case and render a judgment according to law.
